name: H-Block Crew Vanishing SAN Host

securitySheaf.label: Probe IC
securitySheaf.effect: Lookout icons start checking whether the intruder belongs in the alley.

securitySheaf.label: Trace IC
securitySheaf.effect: The host starts following the access path through burner tags and local LTG noise.

securitySheaf.label: Tar Baby IC
securitySheaf.effect: Chain-dog IC tries to pin the intruder in a debt-collector loop.

securitySheaf.label: Killer / Blaster IC
securitySheaf.effect: Shock-glove bruiser icons move from warning to attack.

securitySheaf.label: Gray IC
securitySheaf.effect: Gray-faced enforcer IC applies serious hostile pressure if the decker keeps digging.

securitySheaf.label: Second Gray IC
securitySheaf.effect: A second gray enforcer joins the alley, making continued searching visibly reckless.

securitySheaf.label: Black IC
securitySheaf.effect: One black-armored executioner icon arrives at the end of the sheaf. This is the terminal escalation.

sculpting: A flickering block-party alley host: cinderblock walls, tagged roll-up doors, stolen utility crates, burner-phone shrines, and a vanishing back door that only appears when the gang's tag animation finishes stuttering.
notes: Low-tech H-Block Crew resource host. Easy private-side TNs and mostly one-success gates, but the Security Tally escalates into serious IC if a decker lingers.

nodes.title: LTG Noise Wall
nodes.description: A dirty local LTG wall jitters with gang tags, burner aliases, and dead storefront links. The H-Block door is not always present; it appears only when the tag animation stutters just right.

choices.label: Catch the vanishing SAN window
Graceful logoff

nodes.title: Tagged Alley Door
nodes.description: The vanishing SAN resolves into a spray-painted service door under buzzing sodium light. The lock is crude, but the alley is listening.

choices.label: Log on through the private gang door
Analyze the gang-tag routing
Back out before the door vanishes

nodes.title: Gang-Tag Routing Read
nodes.description: You read the host's rough structure: easy private records, small controls, several paydata lockers, and one deeper bottom-level alias marked Secure Stash. Tell the GM you mapped the H-Block private host outline.

report.title: H-Block host structure mapped
report.detail: Mevin mapped the H-Block private host outline: routine private records, small controls, several paydata lockers, and a bottom-level alias marked Secure Stash.

choices.label: Step through the tagged alley door
Log off with the structure note

nodes.title: Private Block Hub
nodes.description: Inside, the host is a low-tech alley block: cinderblock bays, dented lockers, phone crates, stolen admin tools, and payment notes pinned under knives. Everything is reachable if you move fast.

choices.label: Search chop-shop parts ledgers
Search burner account settlements
Search street payroll scraps
Spoof burner-account controls
Descend toward the Secure Stash alias
Evade trace and leave through the alley

nodes.title: Paydata: Chop-Shop Parts Ledger
nodes.description: You recover a 1-point paydata store: stolen parts lists, buyers, chop-shop timing, and barter-value notes. Tell the GM you recovered H-Block chop-shop ledger paydata worth 1 Paydata Point by default.

report.title: Chop-shop parts ledger paydata
report.detail: Mevin recovered H-Block chop-shop parts ledger paydata worth 1 Paydata Point by default. Confirm names, dates, and sensitivity with the GM.

choices.label: Return to the private block hub
Log off with chop-shop ledger paydata

nodes.title: Paydata: Burner Account Settlements
nodes.description: You recover a 1-point paydata store: burner Matrix accounts, credstick cash-out patterns, payment intermediaries, and short-lived settlement trails. Tell the GM you recovered H-Block burner-account paydata worth 1 Paydata Point by default.

report.title: Burner account settlements paydata
report.detail: Mevin recovered H-Block burner account settlements paydata worth 1 Paydata Point by default. Confirm intermediaries, handles, and sensitivity with the GM.

choices.label: Return to the private block hub
Log off with burner-account paydata

nodes.title: Paydata: Street Payroll Scraps
nodes.description: You recover a 1-point paydata store: lookout payments, crew stipends, errand payouts, and recent for-hire action receipts. Tell the GM you recovered H-Block street-payroll paydata worth 1 Paydata Point by default.

report.title: Street payroll scraps paydata
report.detail: Mevin recovered H-Block street payroll scraps worth 1 Paydata Point by default. Confirm job names, payout recipients, and sensitivity with the GM.

choices.label: Return to the private block hub
Log off with street-payroll paydata

nodes.title: Burner Controls Confirmation
nodes.description: You appear to have access to minor burner-account and message-drop controls. Tell the GM you reached H-Block burner controls; confirm what commands or account changes are legal before applying anything permanent.

report.title: H-Block burner controls reached
report.detail: Mevin reached H-Block burner-account/message-drop controls. Confirm with the GM before treating any account command or message change as permanent.

choices.label: Return to the private block hub
Log off before the lookouts converge

nodes.title: Freight Elevator Bottom
nodes.description: A rattling freight elevator drops below the alley sculpting. At the bottom is a grime-caked lockbox labeled Secure Stash. The label feels fake; the lock feels real.

choices.label: Open the Secure Stash alias
Climb back to the private block hub
Evade trace and leave from the bottom level

nodes.title: Corporate Hire File
nodes.description: The Secure Stash alias opens into the session-specific Corporate Hire file. You recover a protected 2-point paydata store tying the H-Block Crew to a corporate patron or brokered job. Tell the GM you recovered the Corporate Hire file; the GM provides the actual hire details.

report.title: Corporate Hire file / Secure Stash
report.detail: Mevin recovered the H-Block Corporate Hire file hidden under the Secure Stash alias, worth 2 Paydata Points by default. Ask the GM for the corporate patron, broker, target, date, and operational implications.

choices.label: Return to the freight elevator bottom
Escape with the Corporate Hire file

nodes.title: Alley Logoff
nodes.description: The alley collapses back into LTG noise. Tell the GM which H-Block paydata chunks, control access, or Corporate Hire details you reached before leaving.
